name: Google Workspace CLI
description: An agents-first CLI (gws) designed for Google Workspace APIs with machine-readable I/O, schema introspection, input hardening, safety rails, and multi-surface interfaces.

edges.quote: I built a CLI for Google Workspace — agents first.
Agents don’t need GUIs. They need deterministic, machine-readable output
The better pattern: make the CLI itself the documentation, queryable at runtime.
MCP (Model Context Protocol): `gws mcp --services drive,gmail` exposes all commands as JSON-RPC tools over stdio.
Gemini CLI Extension: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli` installs the binary as a native capability of the agent.
`GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_TOKEN` and `GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CREDENTIALS_FILE` enable credential injection via environment
`--dry-run` validates the request locally without hitting the API.
`--sanitize <TEMPLATE>` pipes API responses through Google Cloud Model Armor before returning them to the agent.
